searchText: What do you guys think about using an execution tree to run multiple zkEVMs in parallel and recursively aggregate the proofs? It lets you execute multiple blocks at once but with only logarithmic proving time I’ve never heard of any other scaling solution with overhead logarithmic to the throughput The caveat is that parallel executions can’t touch the same state —unless you handle those edge cases higher in the tree.
